claim: On April 23, 2024, the FTC voted 3–2 to issue the Non-Compete Clause Rule (16 CFR Part 910), declaring it an unfair method of competition under Section 5 of the FTC Act to enter into or enforce non-competes with workers.
evidence: In the final rule, the Commission has determined that it is an unfair method of competition, and therefore a violation of Section 5 of the FTC Act, for employers to enter into noncompetes with workers and to enforce certain noncompetes.
excerpt:
In the final rule, the Commission has determined that it is an unfair method of competition, and therefore a violation of Section 5 of the FTC Act, for employers to enter into noncompetes with workers and to enforce certain noncompetes.

Today, the Federal Trade Commission issued a final rule to promote competition by banning noncompetes nationwide, protecting the fundamental freedom of workers to change jobs, increasing innovation, and fostering new business formation.
